caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent, shallow, round-bottomed glass vessel centered on a plain beige background. The vessel is rendered in shades of light blue and aquamarine, with lines and shadows indicating its transparent quality and the thickness of the glass. The rim of the vessel is flared outward, and the body gently curves down to a slightly narrower base that is still rounded. The drawing is executed with subtle shading to convey the glass’s reflective surface and empty interior. Near the lower right corner, the name "N. Amauten" is written in small letters. There are no other objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Bowl
